name: python-red-black-tree
title: Red-Black Tree
blurb: A red-black tree over bounded integer keys: the in-order walk equals sorted of the live keys after every op, and a shipped checker walking the tree verifies root black, no red father, and equal black height on every path, with remove of an absent key refused by name.
default_description: A red-black tree over bounded integer keys whose walk equals sorted and whose shape answers an explicit checker after every op.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a red node never fathers a red node
